scripts.build: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev:api: pnpm --filter @workspace/market-data run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start
scripts.build:api: pnpm --filter @workspace/market-data run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.build:deploy: pnpm run build:api && pnpm run build:web && pnpm run db:migrate
